plan.geometry: Frozen approved saved crops; no detector, orientation, grid fit, raw recovery or warp rerun
plan.selection: Best weighted validation loss within each arm including epoch zero; rank configurations by validation occupied accuracy, macro F1, then lower inference cost. Historical test is descriptive only.

training.initialization: Every arm independently starts from the frozen epoch-16 checkpoint; fresh Adam state; no test samples used

interpretation: Frozen-weight transformed inputs are sensitivity diagnostics, not fair estimates of optimally retrained crop architectures.
Three equal-budget adapted arms include an unchanged-crop continuation control; one seed and three epochs are a bounded adaptation screen, not convergence or a full from-scratch benchmark.
Context removal and tighter cropping affect different things: suppression preserves target scale, while subcropping changes context and target scale together.
Quarter-detail arms deliberately remove RGB information before restoration; masks and physical targets are unchanged. Upsampling restores dimensions, not source detail.
Historical sessions/timestamps are unavailable. Existing position/source/placement grouping is preserved; independent-session generalization cannot be certified.
No A.3 capture or untouched final holdout is loaded. No geometric augmentation or confidence calibration is implemented.

leakage.checks: Position, source image, identical source bytes, identical placement, known sessions; derivatives inherit split.
leakage.limitation: Historical session IDs/timestamps are unavailable; independent-session or cross-position near-duplicate leakage cannot be certified. No new frames/splits are introduced.

environment.note: No dependencies installed; loaded existing frozen checkpoint without pretrained weight download.

limitations: Three physical historical test positions; unknown historical sessions/timestamps; no independence or generalization claim.
One seed and three-epoch warm-start screen, not convergence.
No current verified per-crop occlusion labels; detail and clutter proxies are confounded.
Exact-board accuracy remains 0/23; selected crop introduces 10 empty-square false positives.
No production promotion; fresh A.3 development capture validation required; final holdout untouched.
